Title: Public preview: Image integrity support in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Body.Content:
Using signed container images helps verify that your deployments are built from a trusted entity and that images haven't been tampered with since their creation. 

Image integrity for AKS allows you to add an Azure Policy built-in definition to verify that only signed images are deployed to your AKS clusters.

 Learn more.
